tie: We can at last describe his tie, an Easter gift from a dressy butcher, his brother in law in Onhava: imitation silk, colour chocolate brown barred with red, the end tucked into the shirt between the second and third buttons — a Zemblan fashion of the nineteen thirties.
If a Negro got legs he ought to use them. Sit down too long, somebody will figure out a way to tie them up.
